Hi Suzanne —

Great to connect at the product forum last week. FinTechCo's use case (real-time risk scoring + multi-tenant privacy requirements) looks like a great fit for a short executive demo of Redwood's Dedicated offering.

Because we need execs in the US, EU and APAC on the call, there are a few calendar constraints I wanted to flag up-front: US folks are on Pacific Standard Time now (fell back last weekend), EU execs are CET, and APAC is Singapore Time (no DST). We've seen DST shifts create a mismatch in proposed slots, so I wanted to take a careful approach rather than ping-ponging.

High level ask: 45-minute demo + 15-minute Q&A with product + CS + your security lead. Can you confirm which of these windows generally works for the FinTechCo execs (I listed in their local times below)?

Suggested slots (we'll confirm exact calendar invites once you pick one):
- Option A: US morning / EU afternoon / APAC late evening — 2026-11-24 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / 00:00 SGT (next day)
- Option B: EU morning / US late afternoon / APAC late night — 2026-11-25 08:30 CET / 23:30 PT (same day) / 15:30 SGT (next day)
- Option C: APAC morning / EU late evening / US very early — 2026-11-26 10:00 SGT / 03:00 CET / 18:00 PT (previous day)

If none of those are plausible, let me know 2-3 windows (with time zones) and I'll run them by our execs and ops to avoid DST confusion.

I've attached a short exec brief and a timezone grid for reference.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
